[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8914]Shifting Mines[/url][/size]


[size=3]Every day, when you enter the mines, you will see how the appearance of the monsters you already know changes.
Don't be afraid of their appearance, they are no different from what you are used to fighting.
A fresh air to make the fight with these beings that inhabit the mines a little more varied. 
The appearance of the monsters changes daily by default, you can configure it in the mod options.
[b][i]There are all kinds of skins. [color=#ff0000]Warning: Some skins are very creepy![/color][/i][/b][/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]The 'Random' variable allows the mines to change daily, but you can modify these options as you wish. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/color][/b][/font]
